sections.label: Seniors incontinence treatment subsidies
sections.summary: Seniors with incontinence are encouraged to seek early treatment; among 2,900 seniors, polyclinic treatment cost a median of under $10 after subsidies in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We certainly share her view that for seniors suffering from incontinence, we would encourage them to seek treatment early.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We do not have data on the total number of seniors suffering from incontinence, as patients could be seeing their doctors for other primary conditions, such as urinary infection, prostate problems or post-stroke treatment, which include treatment for incontinence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Among this group of 2,900 seniors, those who received treatment at the polyclinics paid a median annual cost, after subsidies, of less than $10 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Seniors receive subsidies of up to 75% when they visit polyclinics.

sections.label: MOH and HPB community outreach
sections.summary: MOH takes this approach and HPB will work with Regional Health Systems and healthcare institutions to reach residents and raise awareness on prevention and health promotion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: That is the approach that we take in the Ministry of Health (MOH).

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And HPB will be happy to work with our Regional Health Systems, our healthcare institutions, to be able to reach out to residents in the community to raise awareness and to give talks focusing on prevention, on health promotion.

sections.label: Seniors Mobility and Enabling Fund diapers
sections.summary: Seniors needing adult diapers can apply for assistance under the Seniors Mobility and Enabling Fund, which gives means-tested subsidies of 50% or 80% for consumables such as diapers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If seniors require adult diapers, they can apply for assistance under the Seniors Mobility and Enabling Fund (SMF).

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The fund provides means-tested subsidies of 50% or 80% for consumables, such as diapers.
